bounded_hypothesis: Among confidence-qualified structural dark families (mean pLDDT >= 0.70, length >= 100 aa; N = 2,838) conditioned on >= 2 distinct refined-MAG dRep 95% ANI species clusters with complete 4-flank Bakta-mapped windows (+-2 CDS), test whether low-query-TM families (K, qTM < 0.5 against PDB and AFDB; n = 1,031) differ in cross-species flanking KEGG KO recurrence (binary indicator C_fam and continuous proportion R_fam in [0, 1]) from fold-matched sequence-dark families (Q \ K, qTM >= 0.5; n = 1,807), controlling for species breadth, annotation opportunity, sequence length, pLDDT, and refined GTDB-Tk host phylum, with no inference of novel folds, operon co-transcription, or biochemical function.
critical_issues: C1 (Primary locus eligibility, KO aggregation, and unmapped/unavailable callability): In scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py:134-135, ko_by_sp_primary aggregates KOs from any non-truncated flank of any primary locus before checking locus completeness (is_complete, line 139), allowing edge-truncated loci excluded from n_sp_complete to contribute to the numerator. In results/pilot_family_conservation.tsv, this produces impossible proportions r_fam_primary > 1.0 in 4 families (F25Dr2::F25Dr2_61875_4 = 1.1, F2Dr1::F2Dr1_2447321_2 = 1.5, V2PRr1::V2PRr1_1965096_2 = 1.25, V5PRr1::V5PRr1_986749_4 = 1.5), inflates S52PRr1::S52PRr1_309397_2 from 3 to 5 species, and creates 2 false-positive QnotK calls (38PRr3::38PRr3_622317_3, V45Dr1::V45Dr1_764362_26; shifting QnotK conservation from 14/24 to 12/24 and Fisher p from 0.0581 to 0.1778). In addition, lines 103-124 treat source_file_unavailable and coordinate_mismatch flanks as is_complete=True and has_any_callable=True (97 of 185 non-edge primary loci have >=1 unmapped/unavailable flank; only 88 loci have all 4 flanks mapped in Bakta, yielding N=27 families, K=9/18 vs QnotK=5/9, Fisher p=1.000), while 164/272 coordinate_mismatch flanks on IBEX actually share an exact 3-prime stop codon and strand with a Bakta CDS (61 carrying KEGG KOs). Repair: apply locus eligibility first (requiring 4 Bakta-mapped flanks for the primary gate, optionally auditing exact 3-prime-stop+strand cross-caller matches as an explicit tier), aggregate numerator and denominator over the exact same eligible loci so R_fam in [0, 1], never count source_file_unavailable or unmapped flanks as callable negatives, and report join metrics separately for the 319 primary binned loci vs the 178 unbinned non-primary rows.

C2 (Broken contig_len tie-breaker, broken GTDB-Tk join, and non-converged logistic regression): In scripts/01_select_cohort.py:92, column 2 of contig_to_bin_refined.tsv.gz is the literal string 'refined', so contig_len is 0 for all 534/534 rows in results/pilot_members.tsv; longest-contig multiplicity selection never executes (11/20 multi-copy species pairs select a shorter contig, and 64PRr2::64PRr2_61434_59 sp=4150_0 selects an edge-truncated 35-gene contig over a complete 63-gene contig). Lines 32-33 read unrefined 02_taxonomy/gtdbtk_out/gtdbtk.{bac120,ar53}.summary.tsv (keyed as 10Dr2__SemiBin_0) instead of refined 05_refine/_gtdbtk_refined/ and 05_refine/_gtdbtk_r232/ (keyed with single_/self_), leaving 532/534 pilot member rows without taxonomy and 99/100 pilot families with phylum='unassigned'. In scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py:316-353, phylum_unassigned (55 vs 1) induces quasi-complete separation (coef=-14.7502, SE=424697.1) and non-convergence ('converged': false in results/pilot_conservation_summary.json:57), which DOSSIER.md:120-131 omits while reporting the non-converged estimates as valid. Repair: compute true contig lengths/completeness before primary-locus selection, join taxonomy from 05_refine/_gtdbtk_refined/ and propagate species-cluster R232 taxonomy via Cdb.csv, enforce explicit convergence/finite-SE checks (using penalized/Firth logit or stratified permutation when needed), and report convergence status accurately.

C3 (Permutation null unconditioned sampling and invalid between-arm test statistic): In scripts/03_analyse_conservation.py:262-299, the permutation null loops over all 212 primary loci in primary_evaluable_fams (including 53 edge-truncated loci) and samples pseudo_idx = randint(0, n_cds-1) across all contig positions (33.5% edge-truncated draws in b=0) while the observed primary gate requires complete 4-flank windows. Moreover, line 299 compares the observed between-arm risk difference (-0.2708, at pooled prevalence 42.9% where arm-exchangeability null SD is 0.1336, Fisher p=0.0581) against the difference between random-position arm rates (mean 12.47% vs 10.13%, where low Bernoulli prevalence shrinks the null SD to 0.0681), producing an artifactual p=0.0010. Repair: sample pseudo-focal positions strictly from eligible complete-window positions on the eligible complete-window primary loci, use positional permutation to test within-arm enrichment above contig background, and test the between-arm contrast on family-level background-adjusted excess (C_fam^obs - E[C_fam^pos_null]) by permuting arm labels across families.

C4 (Order/length-only contig mapping, silent missing-bin attrition, and DYNAMIC input checksums): scripts/02_extract_neighbourhoods.py:235-281 maps raw bin contigs to Bakta contigs by FASTA order and length only, even though 209/293 available pilot bins on IBEX contain duplicate contig lengths (29,760 contigs) and Bakta logs (bakta/{parent}/{parent}.log) explicitly record 'id=contig_N, orig-id=<raw_contig>'. Moreover, 14 of 307 unique bins lack Bakta files on IBEX and silently return {}, contradicting DOSSIER.md:69 ('Across all 307 evaluated refined MAG bins... 0.0%'), and INPUTS.tsv:14-17 leaves per-sample/per-bin files as DYNAMIC while omitting bakta/{parent}/{parent}.fna. Repair: verify contig mapping by exact uppercase sequence SHA-256 and Bakta log orig-id (failing closed on mismatch), record the 14 missing-annotation bins explicitly in pilot_join_metrics.json, and emit a manifest with byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes for all sample/bin files read.

C5 (Undocumented 90%-cluster representative membership basis and residual novel-fold/operon prose): Upstream scripts (01_prep.sh, 04_cluster.sh, darkclean_5_mag.sh) show that 04_cluster/clusters.tsv members are 90%-sequence-cluster representatives (mag_dark_rep_ids.txt.gz) rather than all gene instances, which explains why 6,244/12,382 member contigs in 01_select_cohort.py are unbinned when only clusters.tsv is read. Additionally, DOSSIER.md retains 'candidate novel folds' (line 3) and 'operons' (lines 167, 195, 202) despite claiming their removal (line 34). Repair: explicitly document the 90%-cluster representative basis of clusters.tsv (or expand via all_cluster90.tsv before species deduplication) and remove remaining novel-fold/operon claims.
optional_improvements: O1: Report same-strand fraction and intergenic distance distributions across eligible complete-window flanks as secondary descriptive context alongside KO recurrence.
scope_changes_from_original: Condition primary inference explicitly on structural families with >= 2 distinct dRep 95% ANI species clusters possessing complete, Bakta-mapped 4-flank (+-2 CDS) windows (treating truncated, unbinned, or unannotated loci as ineligible/missing rather than biological negatives).

State explicitly whether family membership is evaluated on the 90%-sequence-cluster representatives in 04_cluster/clusters.tsv or expanded across all_cluster90.tsv instances prior to species-level deduplication.
Restrict interpretation strictly to computational flanking KO recurrence and chromosomal colocalisation (excluding novel-fold, operon co-transcription, expression, and adaptive mechanism claims).
reason: The bounded computational neighbourhood-recurrence design is feasible and falsifiable on IBEX, and v2 fixed v1's blank-species admission mismatch and contig-less coordinate keys. However, five critical implementation and inferential flaws remain in frozen h2_v2: (1) primary KO aggregation includes non-truncated flanks from incomplete-window loci (producing impossible R_fam > 1.0 in 4 families and 2 false-positive QnotK calls) while counting unmapped/unavailable flanks as callable complete windows; (2) contig_len is 0 for all 534 pilot member rows and the GTDB-Tk join reads unrefined bin IDs (leaving 99/100 pilot families as phylum='unassigned' and causing non-converged quasi-separated logistic regression reported as valid); (3) the permutation null samples incomplete loci/edge positions and compares the observed between-arm difference against a low-prevalence positional-null difference distribution (artifactual p=0.0010); (4) raw-to-Bakta contig mapping relies on order/length despite 209/293 bins having duplicate contig lengths, 14/307 bins lack Bakta files, and per-sample/per-bin inputs remain DYNAMIC; and (5) the 90%-cluster representative basis of clusters.tsv is undocumented and novel-fold/operon prose persists.
